negative_controls: An automatically extracted search string cannot be promoted to a source-native printed numeral or accepted as an historical edition variant.
Commons's source SHA-1 and page count are metadata, not a verified SHA-256 of bytes acquired in this session.
An independently collated YuanShi original from another work does not establish the printed Xing original digit or prove direct copying.
Even a verified 20th-century typeset 1221萬 would require scoped printing-history analysis and cannot retroactively become a Ming/G893 glyph.
Do not spend more archival effort on this modern OCR candidate ahead of unresolved P0 original Xu-An table-B L132 and 疾-specific algorithm.
next_action: Only revisit the modern commercial printing at exact PDF/native page and visual glyph if an item/page source is easily available; primary next work remains independently legible Xu-An j45 table-B L132 二/三, early source-native 疾 coefficient constructor and 少/微 radix/carry, with original page/image SHA, physical-copy/plate and field matching. Preserve six G893 finals at 0/6.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Modern SSID search-extracted 1221萬 does not attest an ancient variant or independent impression, and it does not disprove the separately read YuanShi 1111萬 original.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Whether the modern commercial book itself actually printed 1221萬, or its PDF search/OCR misrecognized a different numeral, remains untested.
How original Ming Xing juan37 and Ming/Yuan juan54 textual constants relate at physical plate level is unproved.
